case_number: 2023 INSC 616; WRIT PETITION (CIVIL) NO.456 OF 2022 AND CONNECTED MATTERS
summary: Challenge to tenure extension of Director of Enforcement under amended legal framework; validity of Central Vigilance Commission (Amendment) Act 2021, Delhi Special Police Establishment (Amendment) Act 2021 and Fundamental (Amendment) Rules 2021; Court held extension violating prior mandate in Common Cause vs UOI (2021) that no further extension be granted; retrospective amendments held impermissible to nullify judicial mandate; tenure insulation principle established in Vineet Narain and Prakash Singh cases reaffirmed; extensions invalidated as violative of institutional independence standards; challenge to absence of vigilance clearance at extension stage noted.
legal_provisions_cited: Delhi Special Police Establishment Act, 1946 s.4B(1)
Vineet Narain v. Union of India
Prakash Singh v. Union of India
final_judgment: Extensions of tenure quashed; Amendment Acts and Rules held invalid to the extent permitting extensions contravening judicial mandate in Common Cause case; further extensions prohibited; vigilance clearance requirement acknowledged as mandatory for extensions.
